description: Canonical puzzle/solution catalog plus replay-backed fragment flow, transplantable geometry, assembly materialization and relative program scheduling for Opus Magnum Codex.

identity.canonicalStructuralHash: translation/rotation invariant hash preserving program timing
identity.canonicalMechanismHash: translation/rotation invariant hash with normalized program timing
identity.puzzleFeatureFingerprint: hash of solver-relevant puzzle chemistry, molecule topology, available parts and production constraints

fragmentIndex.purpose: Catalog reusable fragment mechanisms with representative canonical geometry and normalized local programs.

fragmentFlowIndex.purpose: Catalog replay-observed transitions with source-local geometry and program-start timing evidence.

relativeTiming.programStartDelta: target fragment program start minus source fragment program start
relativeTiming.eventFirstFromSourceStart: first observed functional event cycle relative to source program start
relativeTiming.eventFirstFromTargetStart: first observed functional event cycle relative to target program start

timingAggregation.preferred: most frequently observed invariant relative timing weighted by observationCount
timingAggregation.variantCount: number of distinct observed timing relations
timingAggregation.variants: relative timing plus weighted observation count

fragmentFlowIndex.convergenceMotifs: same-solution samples retain relativeTimings for each concrete input/output edge

sharedParts.sourceFragmentInstances: all fragment instances that contributed the same physical part signature
sharedParts.programContributions: fragment-local normalized programs retained separately until scheduling

assemblySchedule.purpose: Propagate replay-observed relative program starts through a convergence-aware assembly DAG.
assemblySchedule.root: convergence fragment program start = 0 before non-negative global shift

propagation.globalShift: shift every instance equally when an upstream start would be negative

programMerge.purpose: shift every fragment-local program contribution into the assembly schedule and merge shared physical parts
programMerge.sameCycleDifferentInstruction: reported as a program conflict and scheduleComplete=false

nextGenerationStep: assign target-puzzle reagent/product indices to feed/output fragment instances
assign stable part ids and arm numbers
strip internal provenance fields into a writable solution model
serialize with solution_writer and parse back
iterate geometry, transform and timing variants when validation fails
